item.title: Tree outside 42 Minster Road causing problems with drainage and internet cable., 25th August
item.description:

The tree’s branches are also interfering with our internet cable, resulting in frequent loss of internet signal. We are requesting that the Council assess the tree and consider its complete removal due to the ongoing issues caused by both the roots and branches.

item.description:

The bins outside the flats are always overflowing, we have noted rats, foxes and over vermin ripping the black bags open that they leave on the floor. They have a binstore and should be told to use it and only put the bins out on collection day. On the side of the road garden furniture has been left, flytipped and requires removing. This street is never cleaned properly, its riddled with rats, foxes and other vermin very close to our residence. its simply unacceptable.
